name: Klipped
summary:
**Some moments need a replay.**

The winning shot. The last-second escape. The ridiculous thing your friend just did.

Klipped helps you keep the VR moments you only realize you want to save after they happen.

**Start before you play**
Enable capture in Klipped before your session. It keeps a rolling buffer of recent gameplay, ready for the moment you want to keep.

**Save what just happened**
Use your voice or Manual Save to turn recent gameplay into a Klip. You don't need to plan a highlight in advance.
